usage: orion_pro_admit_real.py [-h] [--environment {owned_local_tls,rds}]
                               [--mode {plan,apply}] [--input INPUT]
                               [--input-sha256 INPUT_SHA256]
                               [--endpoint ENDPOINT]
                               [--endpoint-sha256 ENDPOINT_SHA256]
                               [--release RELEASE]
                               [--release-sha256 RELEASE_SHA256]
                               [--receipt RECEIPT]
                               [--credential-file CREDENTIAL_FILE]
                               [--admission-receipt ADMISSION_RECEIPT]

Qualify retained native SQL and apply explicit minimal publication
derivations. The default is offline. Owned source-free qualification and
actual RDS releases have distinct origins, endpoints and release kinds. Source
bodies are never read.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --environment {owned_local_tls,rds}
                        Explicit released native endpoint; omitted means
                        offline
  --mode {plan,apply}
  --input INPUT
  --input-sha256 INPUT_SHA256
  --endpoint ENDPOINT
  --endpoint-sha256 ENDPOINT_SHA256
  --release RELEASE
  --release-sha256 RELEASE_SHA256
  --receipt RECEIPT     Inspectable operation receipt
  --credential-file CREDENTIAL_FILE
                        Explicit released mode0600 RDS credential file
  --admission-receipt ADMISSION_RECEIPT
                        Exact prior real admission receipt, never a source
                        body
